# UDEN — Unified Development & Employment Network

> [UDEN](https://uden.tech/) is an AI-powered talent assessment, upskilling, and campus recruitment platform bridging the gap between students, job seekers, corporate recruiters, educational institutions, and government skill development missions.

## Core Platform Services & Stakeholder Modules
- [Campus Placement Accelerator](https://uden.tech/for-campus): Enables colleges & TPO officers to host automated placement drives, generate NAAC/NBA analytics, and match students with 150+ corporate recruiters.
- [Pre-Vetted Corporate Talent Finder](https://uden.tech/find-talent): Allows enterprise recruiters to discover candidate profiles mapped to exact technical skill stacks with 48-hour shortlist SLA.
- [Government & State Skill Missions](https://uden.tech/government-partner): GeM-ready, DPIIT-recognized platform for scaling mission-wide student placement tracking across state colleges and skill development centers.
- [AI Skill Gap Analysis & Job Seekers](https://uden.tech/job-seekers): Provides 8-axis technical skill radar evaluations, AI video mock interview feedback, and ₹20,000–₹50,000 cash prize referral rewards.
- [HR Services & Recruitment](https://uden.tech/hr-service-join): Corporate RPO, background verification, payroll compliance, and custom cohort training.
